fact: On 7 May 2025 IFAD and China signed the US$2.268 million SAT-CARE project, which will support Tanzania's Ministry of Agriculture in developing a satellite-based agricultural information system with a digital platform and mobile advisory services, directly benefiting 5,000 smallholder farmers and indirectly up to 1 million.
title: IFAD and China partner to leverage digital solutions for climate-resilient agriculture in Tanzania
